records.scientific_status: Independent research white paper; measured runs with epistemic labels (RUN = executed code, MODEL = interpretation, DESIGN = unrun proposal); not peer reviewed.
records.summary: Born-quantized language representation: Semantic Atoms as binary hypervectors (D=2048), Hamming-distance routing, registration-count learning instead of backprop. Mechanics verified and designable (capacity ~D/34 pairs, noise wall ~48% bit flips, alpha=0.5 contrastive optimum, beta=2 mass policy); learning saturates, not scales - retention of the counting ceiling falls 62-69% -> 17.4% -> 5.6% -> 5.3% from 21k to 2.1M tokens at fixed D. Settled role: small-vocabulary memory/routing layer, not an embedding replacement at scale.
records.title: REGQ: Born-Quantized Language - Semantic Atoms, Hamming Gravity Routing, and the Measured Saturation Limit
